# Distance from Earth to the Sun

The average distance from Earth to the Sun is approximately **93 million miles** or **150 million kilometers**.

This distance is also known as one **Astronomical Unit (AU)**, which is used as a standard measurement for distances within our solar system.

## More precise measurements:
- **Perihelion** (closest point): ~91.4 million miles (147.1 million km)
- **Aphelion** (farthest point): ~94.5 million miles (152.1 million km)

Light takes about **8 minutes and 20 seconds** to travel from the Sun to Earth at this distance.
